author: /root/restart_geometric_model
claim: Actual original fraction field and coordinate embedding of the entire reciprocal cubic and short orders

obligations.name: Hypotheses
obligations.binding: Existing actual quartic fraction field, actual principal localizations, explicit reciprocal tensor equivalence, and exact short affine equivalence; no model-isomorphism assumption.

obligations.name: Objects
obligations.binding: Original fifth character subfield, entire quartic and reciprocal orders, their actual Laurent tensors, and literal short ring A=-30483,B=1993518.

obligations.name: Coverage
obligations.binding: Whole reciprocal and short orders and their entire fraction fields, not just an open-point subset. Completion is not included.

obligations.name: Maps
obligations.binding: Actual localization lift extending the original quartic embedding; exact tensorEquiv inverse; actual whole-order inclusion; exact short coordinateEquiv inverse.

obligations.name: Coefficients
obligations.binding: Retains original embeddings and prescribed Q-coordinate changes. Fraction-ring Algebra structures are explicitly induced by these ring homomorphisms, with actual scalar towers.

obligations.name: Identities
obligations.binding: All embeddings injective; localization tower and fraction-field descent proved; exact u,v and short x,y images; original y is the full product-root element.

obligations.name: Local/global
obligations.binding: Fraction-field descent is justified by composition of actual localizations and the field division criterion. No claim that a field map extends to a proper model.

obligations.name: Evidence
obligations.binding: Four first/debug strict source checks and new target-only recursive audit102; no dependency replay or self-independent acceptance.

obligations.name: Boundary
obligations.binding: Branch extension, global source map, finite-flat rank/norm, fifth regular form comparison, Picard/Jacobian and PEL remain separate.
